summary: 植物能否向邻株传递危险信号，最初受到质疑。后来控制更严的实验发现空气和地下通道都可能传递信息，声音假说及农业应用则仍需进一步检验。

paragraphs.brief: 一个观点受到普遍否定。
sentences: In 1983, plant scientists Jack Schultz and Ian Baldwin reported that the leaves of young maple trees increased their defense systems when exposed to maples that had been damaged by plant-eating (herbivorous) insects.
1983年，植物科学家杰克·舒尔茨和伊恩·鲍德温报告说，在接触植物食用(食用)昆虫破坏的地图时，年轻的红树叶增加了防御系统。
The injured trees, they suggested, were alerting neighbors to the presence of a predator by releasing chemical signals into the air.
他们建议，受伤的树木通过向空气释放化学信号，提醒邻居注意捕食者的存在。
But the plant research community did not accept this.
但植物研究界不接受这一点。
The results were difficult to replicate, critics pointed out.
批评者指出，结果难以复制。
Many also questioned how it could be evolutionarily stable if it benefited neighboring plants but not the plant releasing the signal.
许多人还质疑，如果它有利于邻近的植物，而不是释放信号的植物，它如何能实现进化稳定。
By the late 1980s, most ecologists felt that Schultz and Baldwin’s ideas had been discredited.
20世纪80年代末，大多数生态学家认为Schultz和Baldwin的想法已经失信。

paragraphs.brief: 新证据使人重新相信某个理论。
sentences: A decade later, however, a number of more carefully designed experiments began to yield convincing indications to the contrary.
然而，十年之后，一些设计得更仔细的实验开始产生令人信服的相反迹象。

In 2000, evolutionary ecologist Richard Karban showed that wild tobacco plants became resistant to herbivores when grown in close proximity to sagebrush plants whose leaves had been damaged by cutting.
2000年，进化生态学家Richard Karban指出，野生烟草植物在靠近树枝树枝的草原上生长，对草药植物产生抗药性，树叶因切割而受损。
This change appeared to be in response to chemicals – known as volatile organic compounds or VOCs – released by the sagebrush plants.
这一变化似乎是针对由树枝刷厂释放的化学品(称为挥发性有机化合物或VOCs)作出的。
Other researchers soon reported similar VOC-induced defense responses in several other plants, including lima bean, broad bean, barley, and corn.
其他研究人员很快报告了其他几家工厂(包括Lima豆、大豆、大麦和玉米)类似的VOC引起的防御反应。
And in 2006, Karban showed that VOCs released by damaged sagebrush induce herbivore resistance in plants growing at distances of up to 60 cm, well within the range of sagebrush neighbors in nature.
2006年，Karban 显示，被损坏的白喉释放的活性有机体在生长到60厘米的植物中引起食草动物的抗药性，这种植物的生长距离在自然界的白喉邻居范围内。

paragraphs.brief: 信号发送者可能得到的好处。
sentences: But the question still remains: ‘Why should a plant waste valuable resources on a function which has no obvious advantage for it?’
但问题仍然是：为什么植物浪费宝贵的资源，而这种资源却没有任何明显的好处呢？
One hypothesis is that external communication channels are merely an extension of within-plant signaling.
一种假设是，外部通信渠道只是种植内信号的延伸。

In sagebrush, lima bean, and poplar, VOCs released from damaged parts of a plant induce resistance in intact sections of the same plant, suggesting that each individual plant uses the signals to coordinate its own physiological responses to protect itself.
在树枝、青豆和花粉中，植物受损部分释放的挥发性有机污染物在同一工厂完好无损的部分引起抗药性，表明每个工厂都利用这些信号来协调其自身的生理反应，以保护自己。
Karban agrees, saying: ‘The interplant signaling we see may be a result of plants co-opting that process.’
Karban同意，表示：「我们所看到的植入信号可能是植物串通的结果。

Alternatively, VOC-based signaling between plants may have been favored because it enhances the ‘extended fitness’ of the sender by aiding related plants of the same species: a strategy known as kin selection.
或者，基于VOC的植物间信号可能得到赞成，因为它通过帮助同一物种的相关植物，提高了发件人的 " 扩大健康 " :一种被称为亲属选择的战略。
Over the past few years, a team led by Ariel Novoplansky of Ben-Gurion University of the Negev in Israel seems to have found proof that distress signals can be passed through the plants’ roots.
过去几年来，以色列内盖夫本古里安大学的Ariel Novoplansky领导的团队似乎找到了证据，证明危难信号可以穿过植物的根部。
They planted garden pea plants in rows and subjected the first in each row to conditions similar to those experienced in a drought.
他们将菜豆植物排成一行，每行第一排遭受类似干旱时所经历的情况。
They then evaluated the response by measuring the microscopic holes on leaves, known as pores, which react when there is a shortage of water.
然后，他们通过测量树叶上的微孔，即孔孔，来评估反应，这些洞在缺水时会作出反应。
After fifteen minutes, the stressed plant was seen to be closing its pores, followed by all of its neighbors, one by one.
15分钟后，压力工厂被看到正在关闭其毛孔，紧随其后的是其所有邻居，一个接一个。
Importantly, in a control setup where root contact between neighboring plants was blocked, pores stayed open.
重要的是，在一个控制装置中，邻近植物之间的根接触被封锁，孔一直开着。
Meanwhile, David Johnson’s team at the University of Aberdeen in Scotland have been studying the labyrinths of hair-like fungi that occur around the roots of most plants.
同时，在苏格兰阿伯丁大学的戴维·约翰逊的团队一直在研究在大多数植物的根部周围出现的象发型一样的真菌的迷宫。
These fungi are involved in an important two-way relationship: in exchange for sugars, they provide plants with much-needed phosphorus and nitrogen.
这些真菌涉及重要的双向关系：作为糖的交换，它们为植物提供了急需的磷和氮。
Research in which broad bean plants were infested with aphids – small herbivorous insects – revealed that these networks also served as a channel for warning neighboring plants of the infestation.
大型豆类植物被小虫—— 草食昆虫—— 所淹没的研究表明，这些网络也起到警告邻近植物灾害的渠道的作用。

paragraphs.brief: 一种植物促进另一种植物生长。
sentences: Monica Gagliano of the University of Western Australia believes that plants may even use sounds to alert their neighbors.
西澳大利亚大学的Monica Gagliano认为，植物甚至可以用声音来提醒邻居。
In one study, she demonstrated that chili plants growing next to fennel plants developed more quickly than seedlings grown with other chili plants.
在一项研究中，她表明，在芬乃尔植物旁边生长的辣椒植物比与其他辣椒植物一起生长的幼苗生长的更快。
Gagliano and her colleagues suspect the chili plants were compensating for the presence of the fennel, which is known to release chemicals that inhibit the growth of other plants.
Gagliano及其同事怀疑辣椒植物是补偿芬内尔的存在，众所周知，这释放了抑制其他植物生长的化学品。
Remarkably, however, when plant communication pathways – airborne volatiles, root contact, and common fungal networks – were blocked, the results begged for an alternative explanation.
然而，值得注意的是，当植物通信路径 — — 空气中的挥发性、根接触和普通真菌网络 — — 被阻断时，结果要求另作解释。
‘We think this other channel of communication might be acoustic,’ says Gagliano.
Gagliano说：「我们认为另一条通讯渠道可能是声波的。

But behavioral ecologist Carel ten Cate of the University of Leiden in the Netherlands points out that taking advantage of such benefits would require sensory mechanisms yet to be described in plants.
但荷兰莱顿大学的行为生态学家Carel 10 Cate指出，利用这些好处将需要在植物中描述感官机制。
Despite widespread skepticism, Gagliano has received some encouragement.
尽管人们普遍持怀疑态度，但Gagliano还是受到了一些鼓励。
Richard Karban, for example, is cautiously enthusiastic.
例如，理查德·卡班非常热情。
‘Whether or not the explanation she favors is the right one,’ he says, ‘I think that she’s gotten results that, as a field, we need to come to grips with.’
"不管她是否喜欢的解释是正确的" 他说，“我认为她已经得到了结果，作为一个领域，我们需要面对它。"
Researchers believe that knowledge of this phenomenon could eventually be applied to agriculture, and lead to the cultivation of hardier crops.
研究人员认为，关于这一现象的知识最终可以应用于农业，导致种植更坚硬的作物。
But all agree that there is still much work to be done.
但大家都同意，仍有许多工作要做。
‘Applying our limited knowledge [of plant-communication mechanisms] to agriculture is a big jump,’ says Johnson, ‘but it is definitely on the horizon.’
强生说，"但绝对在地平线上：“将我们有限的[植物通讯机知识应用于农业是一个巨大的飞跃。”

Nevertheless, one message has emerged loud and clear from those studying this new realm of botanical interaction: despite not possessing eyes, ears, or a nervous system, plants are anything but uncommunicative.
然而，研究植物相互作用这一新领域的人发出了一个响亮而明确的信息：尽管植物没有眼睛、耳朵或神经系统，但植物是非触动性的。
‘When I started my PhD (in the late 1980s), all this stuff was considered very weird,’ recalls Ariel Novoplansky.
所有这些东西都被认为是非常怪异的，记得Ariel Novoplansky：“当我开始我的博士学位(在1980年代末)。”
‘Today, there is no doubt.
今天，我们无疑要说：
We now recognise that plants are capable of some very sophisticated exchanges of information with other plants.
我们现在认识到，植物能够与其他植物进行一些非常复杂的信息交流。
This idea is not strange anymore.’
这个想法不再奇怪了。

items.why: 受伤树木警告邻树的说法很难重复验证，进化解释也受质疑，多数生态学家当时没有接受。

items.why: 后来更严谨的研究在多种植物上观察到对挥发性物质的防御反应，重启了早先的假说。

items.why: 辣椒与另一种植物相邻时生长发生变化，研究者借此推测两者间可能存在其他信号途径。

options: 豌豆根部能传递受压信号，隔开根后反应消失；另有研究涉及连接植株的真菌。

The widespread rejection of an idea
一个观点受到普遍否定
受伤树木警告邻树的说法很难重复验证，进化解释也受质疑，多数生态学家当时没有接受。

一种植物促进另一种植物生长
辣椒与另一种植物相邻时生长发生变化，研究者借此推测两者间可能存在其他信号途径。
阻碍植物交流的若干障碍
实验中刻意隔开根和阻隔信号，是为了测试渠道，文中没有归纳自然环境中的交流障碍。
Evidence leading to renewed belief in a theory
新证据使人重新相信某个理论
后来更严谨的研究在多种植物上观察到对挥发性物质的防御反应，重启了早先的假说。
实验有对照设计和渠道隔离，但没有一段专讲研究设备或技术革新。
A suggested benefit to the sender of plant communication
信号发送者可能得到的好处
受伤叶片释放的物质也能传给同株的其他部位；邻株接收到信号可能是附带效果。
flow: 从难以重复的主张到新的证据
早期的树木预警说因验证困难而受冷遇，后续控制更严的实验才让空气中挥发物传信重新受到重视。
解释发信的植株能得到什么
受伤叶片也能向同株别处传信，邻株收到警报可能只是附带结果，这回应了向别株示警为何会演化的疑问。
隔开豌豆根的实验提供了地下传信的线索，相邻植物的生长变化又引出声音等尚待检验的途径。
若能弄清传信的条件，农民或许能借此保护作物，但从实验观察走到实际应用仍需验证。

items.en: Plant communication research in Israel and Scotland Plants may send messages via their ________ according to Ariel Novoplansky of Ben- Gurion University in Israel.
items.zh: 以色列本-古里安大学的阿里埃尔·诺沃普兰斯基认为，植物可能通过自身的________传递信息。
items.why: 题干中的“send messages via their-"对应原文“distress signals can be passed through_”。*“via"就是"through” 的同义替换。空格前有 their。所以填复数名词 roots。

items.en: In one study, Novoplansky’s team planted rows of garden peas, and created conditions like a ________ around the first plant in each row.
items.zh: 在一项研究中，诺沃普兰斯基的团队种下几排豌豆，并在每排第一株周围营造了类似________的环境。
items.why: 研究者让每排第一株豌豆经历类似干旱的条件，对应摘要中的 drought。

items.en: Research at the University of Aberdeen in Scotland, meanwhile, has focused on the networks of ________ which connect the plants beneath the soil.
items.zh: 苏格兰阿伯丁大学的研究则关注地下连接不同植物的________网络。
items.why: 原文把根周围毛发状的真菌网络作为 Aberdeen 团队的研究对象，因此填 fungi。

items.en: Experiments involving broad bean plants and plant-eating insects called ________ have also produced some interesting results.
items.zh: 以蚕豆和一种叫作________的植食性昆虫为对象的实验，也得出了一些有意思的结果。
items.why: 研究让蚜虫侵害蚕豆，原文还用同位语 small herbivorous insects 解释 aphids。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

items.en: It is likely that research into plant communication will one day help to improve our food supply.
items.zh: 对植物通信的研究很可能有一天会有助于改善我们的粮食供应。

items.en: Plant communication could occur as a consequence of internal mechanisms intended to help a single plant.
items.zh: 植物交流可能是由于旨在帮助单一工厂的内部机制的结果。

items.en: Attitudes towards plant communication have changed greatly in recent decades.
items.zh: 近几十年来，对植物通信的态度发生了很大变化。

pairs: 题干概括为传递消息，原文说的是植物传递遇险信号。
subjected the first in each row to conditions similar to
两处都指研究人员让每行第一株豌豆经历模拟环境，like 对应 similar to。
points: 受伤树木警告邻树的说法很难重复验证，进化解释也受质疑，多数生态学家当时没有接受。
研究让蚜虫侵害蚕豆，原文还用同位语 small herbivorous insects 解释 aphids。
clauses: Many also questioned how it could be evolutionarily stable ….
连接词 if 引出“if it benefited neighboring plants but not the plant releasing the signal”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。
By the late 1980s, most ecologists felt ….
“that Schultz and Baldwin’s ideas had been discredited”补足 felt 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 felt 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
lead: Research shows that plants communicate and interact with each other in surprisingly subtle and sophisticated ways.
研究表明，植物以惊人的微妙和复杂的方式相互沟通和互动。
